description: The moto g67 power 5G is a feature-packed smartphone built for those who demand performance and endurance. Powered by the Qualcomm Snapdragon 7s Gen 2 (4nm) processor and running Android 15, it delivers smooth, responsive performance with up to 24GB adaptive RAM via RAM Boost 4.0. The segment-leading 7000mAh silicon carbon battery lasts over 2 days, with 30W TurboPower charging to get you back up quickly. Capture stunning shots with the 50MP Sony LYTIA 600 main sensor, 8MP ultrawide lens, and 32MP front camera, all capable of 4K recording. The 6.7-inch FHD+ display with 120Hz refresh rate, Corning Gorilla Glass 7i, and Pantone Validated colours ensures a vivid viewing experience. Built tough with IP64 water resistance and MIL-810H military-grade durability, it also features stereo speakers with Dolby Atmos and 5G connectivity. Available in PANTONE Cilantro, Parachute Purple, and Blue Curacao with a premium vegan leather body.
